metadata.title: Friend Zone Travel Planner
metadata.description: Plan your trips with friends and keep all your travel details in one place.
metadata.keywords: travel planner, trip planner, itinerary, travel with friends, trip organizer

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your default currency, theme, language, and back up your trip data.

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help with Friend Zone Travel Planner, including troubleshooting, data export, and privacy details.

trip.title: Trip Details
trip.description: View and manage your trip itinerary, budget, map, and expenses.

layout.footer: © {year} Friend Zone Travel Planner. All rights reserved.
layout.dataPrivacy: Your data lives only on this device. No account, no cloud.

home.heroDescription: Plan, organise and recall every stop, stay and journey.
home.createTripDescription: Start with a name and optionally your first stop.
home.deleteTripDescription: This will permanently remove {tripName} and all of its trip data.
home.addNewTripDescription: Create another itinerary and start planning your next adventure.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage defaults for planning, backup, and local device data.

defaultCurrency.label: Default Currency
defaultCurrency.description: The default currency used when creating new trip items.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language used throughout the app.

defaultTimezone.label: Default Timezone
defaultTimezone.description: Used as the default when exporting trip data to iCal and when adding new transport or accommodation items.

dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.description: How dates are displayed throughout the app.

analyticsConsent.label: Share usage data
analyticsConsent.description: Help improve the app by sharing anonymous usage statistics.

cookiesConsent.label: Accept cookies
cookiesConsent.description: Allow cookies to be stored on your device for a better experience.

backup.title: Backup and Restore
backup.description: Export all app data (trips, settings, and preferences) or upload a previously exported backup. Uploading a backup replaces current app data. Maximum upload size is 5 MB.
backup.resetConfirmDescription: This will permanently remove all trips and settings stored on this device.

status.importFailedFileTooLarge: Failed to import app data: file is too large (max 5 MB).

tripPage.deleteTripDescription: This will remove the trip and all linked stops/items.

tripStats.title: Trip Statistics
tripStats.estimationTooltip: This total is an estimate based on current exchange rates and may not reflect actual costs.

stop.deleteConfirm: Delete this stop and all its items? This cannot be undone.

errors.selectCheckInDateTime: Select a check-in date and time
errors.selectCheckOutDateTime: Select a check-out date and time
errors.checkOutAfterCheckIn: Check-out date must be after check-in date

errors.selectDepartureDateTime: Select a departure date and time

welcome.title: Welcome to Friend Zone Travel
welcome.description: Plan, organise and share every stop, stay and journey with your friends — all in one place.

createTrip.title: Create your first trip
createTrip.description: Tap "Plan a trip" to get started. Give your trip a name and an optional start date.

addStops.title: Build your itinerary with stops
addStops.description: Each trip is made up of stops — cities, destinations, or any place you visit along the way.

addDetails.title: Add stays, journeys & expenses
addDetails.description: For each stop, add accommodations, transport legs, and expenses to track every detail.

privacy.title: Your data stays on your device
privacy.description: No account, no cloud. Everything is stored locally on your device and never leaves it.

setup.title: Quick setup
setup.description: Customise a few defaults before you dive in.
setup.analyticsConsentDescription: Help improve the app by sharing anonymous usage statistics.
setup.cookiesConsentDescription: Allow cookies to be stored on your device for a better experience.

dbLoadError.title: Failed to load app data
dbLoadError.description: An error occurred while loading your stored data. You can export a backup before clearing the database — the exported file can be imported via the Settings page after recovery.

budgetTab.estimationTooltip: Totals are estimated using current exchange rates and may not reflect actual costs.

itineraryTab.noStops: Add stops to build your itinerary.

mapTab.noStops: Add stops to see them on the map.

tripStartDateEditor.setStartDateTitle: Set start date to move the entire trip
tripStartDateEditor.adjustDatesDescription: You changed the trip start date. Do you want to shift all accommodation, transport, and expense dates to keep the same relative schedule?

importListener.title: Import shared trip?
importListener.description: This will create a new local trip copy from the share link.
